name: events
desc: Application-facing lifecycle events from Inttegro's native payment sheet.

name: inttegro_flutter
desc: Inttegro's Flutter SDK for native Checkout payment collection.

name: CheckoutAction
desc: Safe description of the next action required from the customer.

name: CheckoutAction.fromJson
desc: Parses and validates a required action from the native bridge.

name: CheckoutAction.new
desc: Creates a customer action required by Checkout.

name: expiresAt
desc: Time after which the action is no longer valid.

name: type
desc: Kind of action the customer must complete.

name: CheckoutActionType
desc: Additional customer action required before Checkout can complete.

name: fromWireValue
desc: Returns the action represented by value, or null when unsupported.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: CheckoutDocuments
desc: Secure documents available for the Order.

name: CheckoutDocuments.fromJson
desc: Parses and validates document links from the native bridge.

name: CheckoutDocuments.new
desc: Creates the set of secure Order document links.

name: invoiceUrl
desc: Secure invoice download URL when available.

name: receiptUrl
desc: Secure receipt download URL when available.

name: CheckoutFailure
desc: Sanitized reason a Checkout lifecycle operation failed.

name: CheckoutFailure.fromJson
desc: Parses and validates a safe failure from the native bridge.

name: CheckoutFailure.new
desc: Creates a sanitized Checkout failure.

name: code
desc: Stable machine-readable failure code.

name: message
desc: Customer-safe description of the failure.

name: recoverable
desc: Whether the customer can retry within the current presentation.

name: CheckoutLineItem
desc: One client-safe line in the Checkout Order snapshot.

name: CheckoutLineItem.fromJson
desc: Parses and validates a line item from the native bridge.

name: CheckoutLineItem.new
desc: Creates one line in a client-safe Order snapshot.

name: id
desc: Public line-item identifier.

name: name
desc: Customer-facing line-item name.

name: quantity
desc: Item quantity when the Order supplies one.

name: total
desc: Total amount for this line.

name: CheckoutMerchant
desc: Merchant identity safe to display in Checkout.

name: CheckoutMerchant.fromJson
desc: Parses and validates a merchant identity from the native bridge.

name: CheckoutMerchant.new
desc: Creates a display-safe merchant identity.

name: displayName
desc: Merchant name suitable for customer-facing Checkout UI.

name: CheckoutMoney
desc: Money in an ISO 4217 currency's minor unit.

name: CheckoutMoney.fromJson
desc: Parses and validates a Checkout amount from the native bridge.

name: CheckoutMoney.new
desc: Creates a client-safe Checkout amount.

name: currency
desc: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

name: value
desc: Amount in the currency's minor unit.

name: CheckoutOrder
desc: Client-safe Order snapshot attached to Checkout lifecycle events.

name: CheckoutOrder.fromJson
desc: Parses and validates an Order snapshot from the native bridge.

name: CheckoutOrder.new
desc: Creates a client-safe Order snapshot.

name: amount
desc: Total amount payable for the Order.

name: documents
desc: Secure invoice and receipt links available for the Order.

name: expiresAt
desc: Time after which the Order can no longer be paid.

name: id
desc: Public Order identifier.

name: lineItems
desc: Client-safe summary of the Order contents.

name: merchant
desc: Merchant identity safe to display to the customer.

name: status
desc: Current Order state.

name: CheckoutOrderStatus
desc: Order states exposed by the Checkout lifecycle.

name: fromWireValue
desc: Returns the status represented by value, or null when unsupported.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: wireValue
desc: Stable value transported across the native bridge.

name: Inttegro
desc: Entry point for configuring, presenting, and observing the native sheet.

name: initializePaymentSheet
desc: Validates and stores configuration for the next presentation.

name: instance
desc: The process-wide Flutter facade for the registered Inttegro plugin.

name: paymentSheetEvents
desc: Typed application-facing lifecycle events for the active payment sheet.

name: paymentSheetTelemetryEvents
desc: Privacy-safe transport diagnostics for a host-owned telemetry pipeline.

name: presentPaymentSheet
desc: Opens the native payment sheet and returns its terminal result.

name: PaymentSheetAppearance
desc: Restrained visual overrides applied to the native payment sheet.

name: PaymentSheetAppearance.new
desc: Creates optional native appearance overrides.

name: backgroundColor
desc: Sheet surface color as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA.

name: cornerRadius
desc: Preferred sheet corner radius from 0 through 40 logical pixels.

name: primaryColor
desc: Primary action color as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA.

name: textColor
desc: Primary foreground color as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA.

name: toJson
desc: Validates and serializes appearance for the native bridge.

name: PaymentSheetCanceled
desc: The customer dismissed the payment sheet before completion.

name: PaymentSheetCanceled.new
desc: Creates a customer-canceled terminal result.

name: PaymentSheetCompleted
desc: The payment sheet completed its client-side payment flow.

name: PaymentSheetCompleted.new
desc: Creates a successful terminal result.

name: order
desc: Final paid Order snapshot.

name: PaymentSheetConfiguration
desc: Configuration stored for the next native payment-sheet presentation.

name: PaymentSheetConfiguration.new
desc: Creates client-owned Checkout and presentation configuration.

name: appearance
desc: Restrained native appearance overrides.

name: features
desc: Optional content and post-payment actions.

name: orderId
desc: Public ID of an Order created and finalized by the backend.

name: purchaseIntentId
desc: Public Buy link whose product choices remain local until payment is submitted.

name: returnUrl
desc: Absolute application URI used after an external provider handoff.

name: telemetry
desc: Host-owned diagnostics and trace-context options.

name: toJson
desc: Validates and serializes configuration for the native bridge.

name: PaymentSheetEvent
desc: One ordered application-facing transition from a Checkout presentation.

name: PaymentSheetEvent.fromJson
desc: Parses and validates a lifecycle event from the native bridge.

name: PaymentSheetEvent.new
desc: Creates one ordered Checkout lifecycle event.

name: action
desc: Customer action required by paymentActionRequired.

name: complete
desc: Whether required payer input is complete for a change event.

name: failure
desc: Sanitized failure attached to failure events.

name: flowId
desc: Random identifier shared by events from one sheet presentation.

name: isRecoverableFailure
desc: Whether this event describes a retryable payment attempt.

name: isTerminal
desc: Whether this event closes the current sheet presentation.

name: occurredAt
desc: Time at which the native SDK emitted the event.

name: order
desc: Client-safe Order snapshot for Order-backed events.

name: paymentMethod
desc: Selected payment method for a change event, when known.

name: sequence
desc: Monotonically increasing event order within the flow.

name: type
desc: Lifecycle transition represented by this event.

name: PaymentSheetEventType
desc: Application-facing payment-sheet lifecycle transitions.

name: fromWireValue
desc: Returns the event type represented by value, or null if unsupported.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: wireValue
desc: Stable value transported across the native bridge.

name: PaymentSheetFailed
desc: The payment sheet stopped because of a terminal failure.

name: PaymentSheetFailed.new
desc: Creates a terminal failure result.

name: failure
desc: Sanitized reason Checkout could not continue.

name: PaymentSheetFeatures
desc: Optional content and actions exposed by the native payment sheet.

name: PaymentSheetFeatures.new
desc: Creates optional content and post-payment actions.

name: allowPaymentMethodChange
desc: Lets the payer replace an attached payment method. Defaults to true.

name: showInvoiceDownload
desc: Offers the invoice after payment succeeds. Defaults to false.

name: showLineItems
desc:
Offers a collapsed, expandable Order summary. Opening it expands the
native sheet before revealing Checkout-provided items. Defaults to false.

name: showReceiptDownload
desc: Offers the receipt after payment succeeds. Defaults to false.

name: toJson
desc: Serializes the presentation flags for the versioned native bridge.

name: PaymentSheetResult
desc: Terminal outcome of one native payment-sheet presentation.

name: PaymentSheetResult.fromJson
desc: Parses a terminal lifecycle event returned by the native bridge.

name: event
desc: The exact terminal lifecycle event returned by the native bridge.

name: flowId
desc: Presentation identifier shared with all lifecycle events in the flow.

name: occurredAt
desc: Time at which the terminal event occurred.

name: order
desc: Final client-safe Order snapshot when one was prepared.

name: sequence
desc: Final sequence number in the presentation flow.

name: PaymentSheetTelemetry
desc: Host-owned diagnostics and optional W3C trace context.

name: PaymentSheetTelemetry.new
desc: Creates telemetry and distributed-tracing options.

name: enabled
desc: Whether diagnostic events and trace propagation are enabled.

name: toJson
desc: Validates and serializes telemetry options for the native bridge.

name: traceparent
desc: Valid W3C traceparent supplied by the host application.

name: tracestate
desc: Optional W3C tracestate, limited to 512 characters and no newlines.

name: PaymentSheetTelemetryEvent
desc: Privacy-safe diagnostic metadata from one payment-sheet presentation.

name: PaymentSheetTelemetryEvent.fromJson
desc: Decodes the strict, versioned payload emitted by the native SDK.

name: PaymentSheetTelemetryEvent.new
desc: Creates a validated in-memory diagnostic event.

name: errorType
desc: Privacy-safe error category rather than a raw message.

name: flowId
desc: Random identifier shared by events from one presentation.

name: httpStatusCode
desc: HTTP status code when a response was received.

name: name
desc: Stable lifecycle or transport event name.

name: operation
desc: Fixed Checkout operation for a network event.

name: requestId
desc: Bounded Inttegro request identifier for support correlation.

name: retryAfterSeconds
desc: Bounded server-directed delay before retrying the operation.

name: sequence
desc: Monotonically increasing event order within the flow.

name: timestamp
desc: Time at which the native SDK emitted the event.

name: PaymentSheetTelemetryEventName
desc: Stable wire names emitted by the native SDK diagnostic stream.

name: fromWireValue
desc: Resolves a native wire value, or returns null when it is unknown.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: wireValue
desc: The exact name emitted across the platform channel.

name: PaymentSheetTelemetryOperation
desc: Checkout operations that may appear in diagnostic events.

name: fromWireValue
desc: Resolves a native operation value, or returns null when unknown.

name: values
desc: A constant List of the values in this enum, in order of their declaration.

name: wireValue
desc: The exact operation name emitted across the platform channel.

desc: Configure and present Inttegro's native payment sheet from Flutter.
